subject: Next steps: FinLogic webinar — MQL buckets & SDR playbook
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-webinar pack: FinLogic — attendee export + suggested MQL split

Hi team,

Thanks again for supporting the FinLogic webinar yesterday — went well overall (strong Q&A). Attendee export attached. I pulled basic engagement metrics in the sheet and sketched a quick MQL split we can use for SDR routing:

- Tier A (High intent): Attended live + asked a product question OR visited pricing page within 24h -> assign to Connor for immediate outreach (1-day SLA).
- Tier B (Warm): Attended live but no QA, opened follow-up emails -> Vivek to sequence (3 touchpoints over 7 business days).
- Tier C (Engaged later): Registered but watched replay -> nurture via targeted content (Laura/marketing).

Action items:
1) Connor — please confirm you can own Tier A and provide a one-liner outreach for the CRM.
2) Vivek — confirm cadence and pick up Tier B list.
3) Laura — please publish replay link + 2 nurture emails. Put replay on the Drive folder and post the link here.

Attachments: finlogic_attendees_20261115.csv (CSV export, columns: name, email, company, role, attended_live, watch_time, q_and_a_flag, page_visits)

Hannah
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Thanks Hannah — looks good. Quick clarifying questions before I start outreach:

1) For Tier A, do we want the outreach to reference the exact question they asked (if present) or keep it generic?
2) Any do-not-contact flags in the export (GDPR opt-outs)?

Suggested one-liner for CRM: "Hi {first_name}, thanks for joining our session on scaling inference at FinLogic — would you have 15 minutes this week to discuss where you're seeing the most friction with latency/cost?"

I can take Tier A today; will push names into HubSpot with a task for 1x call + 1x follow-up email. Connor
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
